get.description: Requires an active session. Order and ticket identifiers are checked against the authenticated owner. Unauthenticated: 401; banned account: 403. FastAI native YAML uses default.fastai.yaml or custom.fastai.yaml, independently of public subscription templates. Only real proxy nodes are emitted; subscription information nodes and subscription-userinfo headers are omitted. Account information is read through the account/subscription JSON APIs. Geo databases are bundled with FastAI; automatic Geo updates and remote HTTP rule providers are prohibited, including custom templates.
